## What's new
- **Paged history** – every card in the **History** tab now has its own pager: **10 per page** by default, with *Per page* 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100 (remembered per service), range (*1–10 of 137*) and first / previous / next / last page.
  - Radarr and Sonarr do the paging themselves, so long histories stay fast; NZBGet's history is cut into pages by ArrHub
  - auto-refresh stays on the page you're on and doesn't close an open *Per page* list
  - history is only loaded while the History tab is open (it used to be fetched in the background on every refresh)
- **qBittorrent in History** – a new *completed torrents* card: finished torrents, newest first, with completion time, state, size, ratio and category, paged like the others. qBittorrent itself keeps no download history, so torrents removed from it aren't shown.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.12.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.11.1...v1.12.0
